state.order: Moritz of Anhalt-Dessau, continue the march of all the infantry east along the high road behind Hülsen. Do not turn the head of the column to the right until it has passed Křečhoř and Hülsen is engaged. Then form to the right and attack in echelon from the left, Tresckow's wing first in close support of Hülsen, each brigade going in on the left of the one before. Bevern's wing is refused, to keep to the north of the high road out of range of the enemy batteries, and is not to be drawn into any attack on the enemy's front.
